Manage who can read this vault

Usage:
  gage recipient [command]

Available Commands:
  add      Authorize a public key and re-encrypt the vault to include it
  remove   Revoke a recipient and re-encrypt the vault without its key
  list     List the keys this vault is encrypted to
  pending  List enrollment requests waiting to be approved
  approve  Admit an enrolling device and re-encrypt the vault to include it
  deny     Remove an enrollment request without granting anything
  verify   Check .age-recipients and config.toml still agree

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
